core_problem_solved: To provide the public Application Programming Interface (API), including annotations and assertion methods, for writing tests using the JUnit Jupiter (JUnit 5) programming model.
key_features: Defines all JUnit 5 testing annotations (`@Test`, `@ParameterizedTest`, `@DisplayName`, `@Tag`, etc.)
Provides the `Assertions` class with all its static assertion methods (`assertEquals`, `assertTrue`, etc.)
Defines the extension model API for creating custom test behaviors
era_and_niche: The standard, modern API for writing unit and integration tests in Java. It is a core component of the JUnit 5 platform and the primary dependency for any developer writing JUnit 5 tests.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**. It is the actively maintained, standard API for JUnit 5. It is the official successor to the API provided by the legacy **`junit:junit`** (JUnit 4) artifact.
